title: AA Academy publication allowlist
description: docs/learn/allowlist.yaml (decision D13): the only skill, steering and CONTEXT.md sections the learn bundle publishes, one entry per section, default deny; and the catalog pages an agency (partner tier) module may cite. A change here is reviewed as an access change. Checked by tools/docs/check_learn.py (AA-1104).

ref.description: skill:<name>#anchor, steering:<name>#anchor or context:<repo>#anchor; a whole file is never allowlisted.

tier.description: staff: every staff role may read it; partner: agency learners may read it too.

reason.description: Why a learner needs this section.

partner_pages.description: Catalog IDs a partner-tier module may cite. Default deny: an agency learner sees nothing else.
